title: F3 SD Card Health Check Status Mix
dataSources: Lightroom photo exports (`lightroom:photo`), Flickr photo metadata (`flickr:photo`), ShutterCount body audits (`shuttercount:camera`), and F3 card tests (`f3:card`).
app: Adobe Lightroom exports, Flickr API metadata, ShutterCount camera audits, and F3 SD-card health checks sent to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=f3:card
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(test_status,"unknown"))
| stats count as events by status_value
| sort - events
description: Breaks down the current mix of states reported by the F3 SD card health check feed.
value: A status-mix panel provides quick at-a-glance context before you investigate specific outliers.
implementation: Map the source's `test_status` values into a small set of clear labels and chart the resulting counts.
visualization: Donut or bar chart of event count by status.
grandmaExplanation: It builds the overall mood of your F3 SD card health check feed by counting how many events are healthy, warning, or bad.
